speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
text: asked the Minister for Transport what are the measures and efforts to combat the spread of COVID-19 in our public buses and trains under DORSCON yellow, orange and red framework.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: Since the start of the outbreak of the Coronavirus Disease of 2019 (COVID-19), the Ministry of Transport (MOT) has worked closely with our bus and rail operators and the National Transport Workers’ Union (NTWU) to implement relevant precautionary measures.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: Messages on maintaining public hygiene have also been frequently shared with public transport workers.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: These measures seek to give commuters peace of mind to continue with their regular daily journeys.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: Commuters are also reminded to practise good personal hygiene.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: Commuters who are unwell should avoid public transport and crowded places.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: We will continue to work with the Ministry of Health, our public transport operators and NTWU to introduce appropriate measures and efforts to combat the spread of COVID-19 as the situation evolves.
